transcript.text: Hello folks, we do have some interesting news for RuneScape Dragon Wilds today as previously the game already suffered
from one save corruption issue. However, as of today the devs have made a separate announcement addressing an
entirely different and new save corruption problem, which can be avoided if you just don't change worlds in game.
Alongside this we'll be touching on RuneFest which arrives in just 3 days time and should reveal tons more details
regarding the Luminance and Shadows of Ashfall updates as well as the Blood Crystal Saga as a whole. And then
finally, we also have further details regarding the previous save corruption issue which we'll cover more towards the
end. Plenty for us to get through and as always we are not wasting any time, so let's get started.
Okay, so the first thing I want to touch on for today is the recent issue of console save corruption. The game
actually suffers from two different types of save corruption right now. The previous issue has had its cause removed
meaning no new players can be affected. However, as of the most recent update a day or so ago there have been multiple
reports of save corruption on console. And so the official announcement that rolled out just a few hours ago does go
as follows. Hi adventurers, we are aware of a bug that is causing character saves on consoles to not store inventory,
skill, or quest progression on the character you're playing on when switching worlds. This is a separate
issue from the save corruptions experienced at launch which we discussed above. We're investigating the cause of
this and we're hoping to apply fix as soon as it's been tested. The team are currently traveling from all over to
pitch in for RuneFest, but this patch is our top priority. So we're working remotely as we travel on route. We're
prioritizing this fix over everything else with the aim of being able to deploy a hotfix by the end of this week.
Whilst we test a fix, please avoid hopping to multiple worlds on one character until the hotfix is sent out.
We'll be sharing more information about when it will go live to resolve this issue as soon as possible. Now
essentially, if you don't change worlds then you'll be absolutely fine. Otherwise, if you've already been
affected then you'll have to wait for further news regarding what kind of fix can be done. Just yesterday the devs
addressed the previous save corruption issue which I'll be circling back to later on in the video, but their
solution is that they can't recover the save data and will instead be giving players geared and somewhat leveled
characters to replace the ones they lost. If you are affected by this recent issue, then there's a timestamp right
here for further information regarding what they've said about save corruption. Otherwise, I have broken up the two
separate issues in this video by covering RuneFest next. In summary though, don't change worlds on console
and the devs will have further news and hopefully a fix by the end of this week. Now, the next thing I want to cover for
today is of course RuneFest. I've brought this up a couple of times before in previous videos. However, we are now
only 3 days away from the event starting and so I wanted to go through what we can all actually expect. To begin, the
events itself covers the entirety of RuneScape. So whilst Dragon Wilds will be a part of it, there will be multiple
sections, announcements, showcases, and whatever else specifically just for RuneScape 3 and Old School RuneScape
instead. It also runs over the course of 2 days, so we may have to wait until close to the end for big announcements
or reveals. Otherwise, in regards to Dragon Wilds, we're expecting a fair bit of information about the upcoming Lumina
updates, which instead of just being one large update coming in the next few months, will actually be multiple
updates between now and the end of the year, introducing a bunch of new content ranging from the new prayer skill, a new
set of equipment, a new building kit, magic tree seeds for farming, deep changes to ranged combat, and hopefully
other surprises we don't currently know about. To reiterate, this content will come in installments over the next few
months. So this October update could very well have some of these things as could the November and December updates,
too. But the certainty is it will all be here by the end of the year. We're also expecting more information regarding
2027 in general as the beginning of the year marks the end of the Coldja Saga and the start of the Blood Crystal Saga.
And so it's likely the devs will have plenty to share in regards to where they intend to take things next. So far,
Coldja Saga has basically consisted of all new content introduced to the game since early access began. And so we can
expect that this next saga will include these same massive updates over the course of multiple months. And then,
finally, the last thing we're expecting to hear about would be the Shadows of Ashan Fall update, which has been
mentioned multiple times before by the devs. Put simply, it's an update that intends to increase the amount of
players that can play on any given world. It's said to increase the map size extensively, too, whilst also
adding new things like player economy, trading, and new ways to interact with dragons. Whilst this is all we know
about the Luminance and Shadows of Ashan Fall updates, as well as the Blood Crystal Saga for now, the devs have
confirmed they'll be sharing many more details at RuneFest about all three. And hopefully, some other things that we
don't currently know about, but of course, we'll just have to wait and see. Naturally, this is only a few days away
now, so you can expect plenty of videos from myself as and when it's all happening, but otherwise, we just have
to sit and wait patiently until RuneFest is finally here. Now, the last thing I wanted to cover for today would be the
recent announcement made regarding saved player corruption. This, of course, isn't to be confused with the other save
corruption issue we spoke about earlier on. We have an official update from the devs regarding this, and so, it goes as
follows. Hello, adventurers. Around a thousand of our players across consoles and PC Game Pass during the launch
window were affected by an issue where disconnecting the game, putting consoles in sleep mode, or otherwise would lead
to saves being rendered unreadable or inaccessible. The main culprit of this was editing your character's appearance.
We've since disabled this feature and rolled out a fix to prevent this corruption from happening again. We've
been working closely with our console partners to exhaust every possible option to work on these affected saves.
How long these take to implement varies from option to option, but our intent is to roll out a safe alternative to
resolve this issue, as giving up on your saves and asking you to start again doesn't sit right with us. What we've
settled on is the simplest, safest, and earliest change we can make. We will be cleaning corrupted character saves, and
in their places, we will install a character with tier four equipment back into the world you had progressed in.
Your name, appearance, and your access to private chests will be unaffected. We will also be pre-leveling you in skills,
as well as setting you up with vital equipment to get you back into the fight. We've collected the average
levels as an aggregated target for what we're putting levels at as a chance for us to produce a consistent benchmark
save to get folks back in. For some users, this will be a bit of a boost in places. I won't read these out, but I'll
leave the numbers on screen momentarily, and I will also circle back to them very shortly. For now, our priority is
focusing this fix for our 1.0.1 update in mid-October. We're continuing to work on improvements across every aspect of
RuneScape Dragon Wilds, and that includes tech and support towards protecting saves, both local and cloud
saves, using the online framework we have in place today. We've removed the edit appearance button whilst work on
this continues to prevent this as a source of save loss, but we're committed to keeping you updated on our
investigation, our goals, and our potential resolutions. We'll share any and all updates we have on this as we
progress. Now, in a nutshell, it will appear in the actual corrupted data itself isn't going to happen, and
instead anyone affected will be given a new character with advanced gear and all of these levels. However, it is also
only characters that are affected by this issue, so your world, bases, equipment, and supplies all remain
exactly the same, meaning you can pretty much pick right back up from where you left off. The only true difference here
is the list of skill levels, as I think most folks will find this is an increase to what they previously had. The devs
have likely set things up so far ahead here as it's a single across-the-board fix for a range of different players all
at different progression stages of the game. And so, it's best to put some of you slightly further ahead of where you
were as opposed to putting some of you much further back. It isn't a perfect fix, but all things considered, it is a
solid solution to an otherwise really big issue for some. Whilst it shouldn't have occurred, hats off to the devs for
allocating some time and resources to doing something about it as opposed to just saying sorry and moving on. But, I
also feared now the bigger issue is just how long this fix will take to roll out. They've said they aim to apply it with
the 1.0.1 update for mid-October, so roughly two or so weeks away from now, but some players have been affected with
this issue for close to two weeks already, and they were affected within the very first days. Meaning, by the
time this rolls out, it will have been close to or over one whole month, and I'm sure the vast majority of them will
have lost interest if they haven't started a new save file already. It simply is what it is. I'm sure they
would roll it out quicker if they could, and despite it being a game-breaking issue, at least something is being done.
Now, in summary, folks, whilst the game has some truly massive and exciting updates on the way, it's simultaneously
suffering with two different save corruption issues that the devs are anywhere from a few days to a couple of
weeks away from resolving. Save corruption is just about the worst issue a game can have, and so despite all of
the positive hype, excitement, and whatever else, it really is a shame that these issues do exist. To make matters
worse, because RuneFest will keep a lot of the devs very busy, fixes for these big issues are taking longer than they
otherwise would. And so, I could imagine it stressing the devs out quite a bit. Again, it quite simply is what it is,
but hopefully it's all resolved much sooner rather than later. I'll keep my eyes peeled and report more news as and
when, as I already do with many other survival, Souls-like, and action RPG titles already, and so that is basically
to say that do feel free to treat this channel as your one-stop spot for all things RuneScape Dragon Isles moving
forward. Anyway, that would be it for this one, folks. I'll be back soon with plenty more, and I do, of course, have a
range of guide and news videos on the channel already, so do feel free to stop on by [music] and check things out.
Otherwise, thanks for watching, folks, and until next time, peace.
